payoff: Predict PostgreSQL query behavior correctly before running SQL, then prove it using a reproducible psql workflow.
learningOutcomes: Menjelaskan schema, primary key, duplicate rows, dan perbedaan relation vs SQL result set
Menurunkan TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN dan memprediksi efek NULL/NOT IN pada WHERE
Memilih numeric dan time data types dengan sadar serta membedakan literal inference vs cast
Menentukan cardinality, DISTINCT, dan urutan yang benar untuk ORDER BY/LIMIT
Membuat 20 prediksi sebelum eksekusi, kemudian membuktikannya dengan psql dan SQL assertions
mentalModel: Typed input rows → comparisons (TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN) → WHERE keeps TRUE only → projected rows may duplicate → DISTINCT optionally removes duplicates → total ORDER BY makes LIMIT deterministic; assertions verify the guaranteed contract, not incidental execution output.
relationshipGraph: schema + typed rows → expressions → TRUE|FALSE|UNKNOWN → WHERE(TRUE only) → result rows (possible duplicates) → DISTINCT? → ORDER BY with tie-breaker? → LIMIT

concepts.title: Relational model, SQL rows, and primary key
concepts.mechanism: A table's schema gives columns/types; a primary key enforces non-null unique identity rather than physical ordering.

concepts.title: SELECT, FROM and WHERE
concepts.mechanism: Expressions can be selected without FROM; a query over a table filters rows via predicates before projecting output.

concepts.title: TRUE, FALSE and UNKNOWN
concepts.mechanism: Ordinary comparisons with NULL yield UNKNOWN, and AND/OR/NOT must be reasoned by truth tables.

concepts.title: WHERE and NULL-safe comparisons
concepts.mechanism: WHERE retains only TRUE; IS NULL and IS DISTINCT FROM have different contracts from ordinary equality.

concepts.title: NOT IN with NULL
concepts.mechanism: NOT IN can evaluate UNKNOWN if no matching non-null element exists while right-hand options contain NULL.

concepts.title: Duplicates and DISTINCT
concepts.mechanism: SQL SELECT can yield duplicate result rows; DISTINCT removes duplicates but does not imply ordering.

concepts.title: PostgreSQL data types and implicit casts
concepts.mechanism: Typed attributes matter; exact numeric money, nullable boolean, UUID/date/timestamptz and cast selection must be distinguished.

concepts.title: Deterministic ORDER BY and LIMIT
concepts.mechanism: Without explicit total ordering, LIMIT does not define which subset is returned. Tie-breakers specify stable selection.

misconceptions: NULL is zero, empty string, or FALSE
NOT IN ignores nullable right-hand elements
A primary key physically orders the table
LIMIT without ORDER BY chooses the same rows reliably
A successful psql exit proves a prediction correct without an assertion
The display string [NULL] is stored data rather than a psql output setting
An assertion may force an accidental LIMIT order that SQL never guaranteed
practice: Trace per-row predicate truth value on five payment fixtures before running SQL
Lock each group of five SQL predictions before executing that group; retain original prediction text
Cover NULL, NOT IN, null-safe comparisons, duplicates, DISTINCT, numeric types, tie-breaking and unordered LIMIT across 20 cases
Use psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 and DO/RAISE EXCEPTION or expected-result files to verify each predicted contract
Repair misconceptions with a fresh analogous case without weakening the 18/20 original threshold

reviewQuestions.prompt: Pada seed 5 pembayaran, SELECT id FROM payments WHERE status <> 'PAID' ORDER BY id; menghasilkan apa?
reviewQuestions.explanation: FALSE pada PAID, TRUE pada FAILED dan PENDING, UNKNOWN pada NULL; WHERE hanya menerima TRUE.

reviewQuestions.prompt: Apa hasil SELECT 8 NOT IN (1, 2, NULL)?
reviewQuestions.explanation: Tidak ada kecocokan numerik; perbandingan terhadap NULL tetap UNKNOWN dan konjungsi NOT IN menghasilkan UNKNOWN.

reviewQuestions.prompt: Dari seed lima pembayaran (PAID dua kali, FAILED, NULL, PENDING), berapa row SELECT DISTINCT status FROM payments?
reviewQuestions.explanation: DISTINCT mereduksi dua PAID menjadi satu; NULL adalah satu nilai duplicate group tersendiri, bukan otomatis dihapus.

reviewQuestions.prompt: Dua payment memiliki created_at sama. Mana yang memberi subset LIMIT 2 secara deterministik?
reviewQuestions.explanation: Tie-breaker id yang unik membuat total order; timestamp saja tidak menjamin tie-order.

reviewQuestions.prompt: Cara mana memberi bukti yang dapat direproduksi untuk prediksi SQL?
options: Prediksi sebelum eksekusi + psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 + assertion yang RAISE EXCEPTION jika mismatch
Jalankan query di ORM tanpa menyimpan prediksi
reviewQuestions.explanation: Sukses menjalankan SQL bukan bukti hasil sesuai ekspektasi. Fail-hard assertions memverifikasi output; prediksi disimpan sebelum melihat hasil.
